ben_sales_se: Hey team — running presales for a large fintech evaluating Redwood. Key asks: EU-only data residency for POC, BYO-KMS, and a routing guarantee (no cross-border egress) during the trial. Also wants pricing delta if we need Dedicated capacity for tenant pinning. Can ops/infra confirm feasibility and rough uplift? :thinking:

maria_solutions: Thanks Ben. Customer name: ShieldBank. POC timeline: 4 weeks, starting next month. They want a one-tenant pin for all EU traffic and the BYO-KMS flow for key wrapping. They're asking for a short cert list of sub-processors touching data in eu-west-1.

josh_infra: Short answer: doable. We can pin a tenant to eu-west-1 on Dedicated or Private. Hosted can route to eu-west endpoints but we don't currently guarantee 100% physical-only residency for hosted (some control plane metadata may be outside region). For BYO-KMS we support KMS proxies for the Private plan; for Hosted we have limited BYO-KMS via our managed bridges (needs security review).

anika_product: Adding product notes: we have two routing knobs: 1) tenant_pin (hard affinity to region/hardware), 2) region_preference (soft affinity with failover). Tenant_pin requires Reserved capacity or Private. region_preference works for Hosted but can fall back to other regions if capacity is constrained.

ben_sales_se: @josh_infra can you confirm the expected cost uplift percentage ballpark for Dedicated tenant_pin vs. Hosted region_preference for a low-throughput POC (50 rps, chat generation)? Customer will accept higher cost for residency but wants a number to include in the SOW.

josh_infra: Ballpark: Dedicated tenant_pin -> ~+40–60% over hosted blended, because you reserve GPU nodes and we add network isolation and tenant mapping. Hosted region_preference -> minimal uplift unless you request enforced regional handling (then +15–25%). I'll ping infra finance for more precise calc.

leo_legal: On subprocessors: we can provide the EU subprocessor list for eu-west-1 and an attestation template. We cannot disclose on-prem partner infra IPs, but we can give vendor names and SOC/ISO certs. Also need to surface whether BYO-KMS requires external data flow for key wrapping (depends on model).

maria_solutions: ShieldBank will want the attestation + a short network diagram showing no egress to non-EU regions during the pinned POC. Any existing diagram we can reuse?

josh_infra: I can drop a minimal network diagram. It'll show: customer VPC -> customer-controlled KMS (BYO) over TLS -> Private control plane (control metadata, can be out-of-region) -> inference nodes in eu-west-1 with no cross-region egress for payloads. I'll annotate that control plane metadata may transit via our central control plane (we can add encryption and DPA language).

ben_sales_se: Nice. For the BYO-KMS handshake, ShieldBank also asked about HSM-backed keys and whether we can accept wrapped DEKs only (no persisted plaintext). Is that supported?

anika_product: We support wrapped DEKs with HSM-backed KMS on Private. For Hosted we can accept wrapped keys but we will need a short integration that validates unwrap/rewrap behavior — that is treated as an enterprise onboarding item.

maria_solutions: Also: any quick sample for how routing header looks so their network/security can validate the request path? I can share with them a curl example.

josh_infra: Example header to pin region (for testing on Hosted region_preference):

```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example.com/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${TOKEN}" \
  -H "X-Redwood-Region-Preference: eu-west-1" \
  -d '{"model":"rwd-small","input":"hi"}'
```

For Dedicated tenant_pin there is a tenant-level config; no per-request header needed.

ben_sales_se: Perfect. Next items for handoff: 1) annotated network diagram (josh) 2) EU subprocessor list + attestation (leo) 3) rough pricing uplift and a quick SOW line for Dedicated tenant_pin (josh + finance) 4) BYO-KMS integration notes for ShieldBank's security team (anika). I'll assemble and send to them by EOD tomorrow.

leo_legal: I'll prepare attestation + vendor certs. ETA 1 business day.

josh_infra: I'll sketch network diagram + cost ballpark. If finance chimes in, I'll update numbers.

anika_product: I'll add the BYO-KMS checklist and a short note about wrapped DEKs and replay protection.

deploy_bot: Deploy note: pinned-tenant feature is gated; onboarding ticket required -> https://redwood.internal/tickets/ONB-2389 (auto-created).

ben_sales_se: Thanks all. One last ask from ShieldBank: they want to test a short failover scenario (eu-west-1 down) and see that requests are rejected rather than routed out-of-region. Can we do an enforced-no-fallback mode for the POC?

josh_infra: Yes, on Dedicated/Private we can set 'enforce_region_residency: true' — that will respond with 409 or 503 rather than failing over. Hosted region_preference cannot promise that. I'll include the behavior in the diagram + SOW note.

maria_solutions: Great — I'll capture this in the presales summary to ShieldBank. Will post the SOW draft here when ready. :rocket:
